item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a concave mirror held close to a tooth so the tooth can be examined. Plane mirrors and convex mirrors are also available.

Which choice correctly matches the tool to the need?

options.A: A concave mirror, because it can give an enlarged image when the tooth is close to it.
options.B: A plane mirror, because every mirror always gives an enlarged image.
options.C: A convex mirror, because it gives an enlarged image of a nearby tooth.
options.D: A concave mirror, because it is chosen only when the tooth is far from the mirror.
